paths.description: Homepage/search portal archetype at desktop, mobile, preference, accessibility, performance, privacy and memory conditions.
Primary search-results journey using a representative query; selected to test the core task and results template.

findings.summary: Reduced-motion preference does not stop all non-essential motion.
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion evaluate probe confirmed the media query matched but still found a running 6000 ms animation.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable or substantially shorten non-essential animations inside prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: State changes do not expose evidence of authored View Transitions.
findings.evidence: DOM and interaction probes found no authored transition behavior; document.startViewTransition is available but the search suggestion and overlay states swap without a directional transition.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance meaningful state changes with same-document View Transitions, retaining an instant fallback.

findings.summary: The homepage omits a viewport meta tag and is scaled as a 980 px desktop layout on a 360 px screen.
findings.evidence: The mobile layout primitive reported hasViewportMeta=false and innerWidth=980 at a requested 360 px viewport; the screenshot shows tiny, densely packed text and controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> and make the homepage layout reflow at narrow widths.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is not visibly indicated on primary controls.
findings.evidence: The focus probe programmatically focused the language buttons, sign-in link, service links and search input; computed outline remained none and box-shadow none for nearly all sampled controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a high-contrast :focus-visible indicator that is not removed by component resets.

findings.summary: The fixed cookie banner consumes a large portion of the mobile viewport on load.
findings.evidence: The 360x800 screenshot shows the cookie notice covering roughly the bottom third of the viewport and obscuring feed content before interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact, content-preserving consent surface and keep essential choices available without covering the primary page.

findings.summary: Cookie controls are built from generic divs with button roles rather than semantic buttons or a dialog.
findings.evidence: The structure probe lists Allow all, Allow essential cookies and Settings as DIV role=button, and no dialog element/role is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Use native button elements and a dialog for modal settings, with labelled controls and platform focus management.

findings.summary: Largest Contentful Paint is slow under Lighthouse mobile conditions.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP at 5.2 s (score 0.23); the independent trace measured 2.42 s but still showed a 1.36 s load and the HAR identified a slow 218 KB image and substantial script delivery.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the actual LCP resource, reduce document/server delay, and defer feed, ad and analytics work until after core search UI is ready.

findings.summary: The page ships avoidable JavaScript and third-party work.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 86 KiB unused JavaScript, including one bundle 99.9% unused; HAR recorded 711 KB of scripts across 21 requests.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split optional feed and ad features, conditionally load dependencies, and remove duplicate or unused code from the initial route.

findings.summary: Some small text fails WCAG AA contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found the red EUR delta at 4.26:1 against #242425 at 11 px and additional grey text at 4.31:1, below the required 4.5:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust text colors or backgrounds to meet at least 4.5:1 for normal text in every theme.

findings.summary: News images lack explicit alternative text and intrinsic dimensions.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found all 14 sampled img elements without alt, width or height attributes; seven content thumbnails are part of news cards.
findings.suggestedFix: Give meaningful images concise alt text, decorative images empty alt, and provide intrinsic width/height to reserve layout space.

findings.summary: Security policy coverage is incomplete and the CSP permits unsafe evaluation.
findings.evidence: Headers show HTTPS, HSTS, nosniff and X-Frame-Options DENY, but CSP script-src includes unsafe-eval and Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy headers are absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unsafe-eval by refactoring dependent scripts, then add explicit Referrer-Policy and least-privilege Permissions-Policy headers.

findings.summary: The initial page has a large cross-origin analytics and cookie-sync footprint.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 76/121 cross-origin requests and 1.58 MB of 1.81 MB transferred cross-origin. Lighthouse found 24 third-party cookies; cookie probes found many SameSite=None identifiers lasting 400 days.
findings.suggestedFix: Load non-essential analytics only after consent, eliminate cookie-sync redirects, shorten identifier lifetimes and batch/minimize telemetry.

findings.summary: Indexing signals are incomplete: no canonical URL is exposed and /sitemap.xml returns a 404 page.
findings.evidence: The metadata probe found canonical=null while hreflang variants exist; fetching /sitemap.xml produced a Yandex 404 document.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish a canonical URL for the public homepage and expose a valid sitemap location in robots.txt or at the conventional endpoint.

findings.summary: Image and ad asset delivery is oversized for rendered dimensions.
findings.evidence: The images probe marked all 14 sampled images oversized and seven without responsive sources; Lighthouse estimated 62 KiB savings on one ad image.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve width-appropriate AVIF/WebP variants with srcset/sizes and avoid original-size ad imagery for small placements.

findings.summary: The page is not eligible for the back/forward cache.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported five BFCache failure reasons, including actionable Cache-Control: no-store combined with cookie modification.
findings.suggestedFix: Avoid no-store on the top-level document where private/no-cache semantics suffice, and minimize lifecycle behavior that blocks BFCache.

findings.summary: A high-value search and assistant surface exposes no observable structured agent tools.
findings.evidence: DOM and metadata inspection found ordinary links/forms but no WebMCP or agentic tool registration; non-JS discoverability coverage was only 20%.
findings.suggestedFix: Where safe, expose search and assistant actions as constrained, documented WebMCP tools rather than requiring agents to scrape UI.

taskList.title: Make the homepage genuinely mobile-responsive and restore visible keyboard focus
Reduce LCP, unused JavaScript and initial cross-origin work
Minimize analytics/cookie-sync collection and harden browser policies
Replace intrusive/custom cookie controls with semantic, compact controls
Respect reduced motion and progressively enhance state transitions
Evaluate safe structured agent tools for search
